summary: MasTec, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its completed public offering of $650 million aggregate principal amount of 5.850% senior unsecured notes due 2036, issued under a base indenture supplemented by a twenty-second supplemental indenture. The notes rank equally with other senior unsecured debt, are effectively subordinated to secured debt, and are not guaranteed by subsidiaries. Interest is payable semi-annually starting March 30, 2027, with maturity on September 30, 2036. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
